prerequisites: For rotation/swap: jack, stands, torque wrench
parts_checklist: Optional TPMS sensors on new tires

adaptive_rules.coach_note: Rotate about every 5,000–8,000 miles unless the manual says otherwise.
Regular snow/ice? Winter tires beat all-seasons near freezing.
Heavier EVs/hybrids: keep PSI exact and watch inner shoulder wear.
Tow/dirt use: inspect all four, not just the fronts.
Staggered sizes often can't cross-rotate — a tire shop prevents wrong-axle mounts.
Wear bars, cords, sidewall bulge, or sidewall puncture = don't drive far.

steps.title: Set cold pressure
steps.coach_encourage: Placard PSI beats sidewall 'max' every time. Nice discipline. Nice momentum — you're about 28% through.
steps.description: Cold tires. Door-jamb numbers for all four (+ spare). TPMS may need a short drive to clear.
steps.safety_warning: Underinflation overheats; overinflation wears the center.

variants.description: EV tip: wrong PSI shows up as range loss and inner wear — stick to the placard.

steps.title: Tread & damage scan
steps.coach_encourage: This step is important — two careful minutes prevent roadside drama. You're crushing it — roughly 43% done.
steps.description: Measure the shallowest groove. Wear bars (~2/32") = plan replacement. Scan sidewalls for cracks, nails, bubbles.
steps.safety_warning: Exposed cord or sidewall bubble — do not drive.
steps.trust_nudge: If you're unsure about damage, stop and find a nearby shop — that's the smart call, not quitting.

steps.title: What is wear telling us?

steps.coach_encourage: Inspection-only is a complete win if that's today's goal. Look at you — about 71% complete. Keep going.

steps.title: Rotate or swap the set
steps.coach_encourage: Mark positions first — future you will thank you. Slow and steady. Final stretch — you're about 86% through.
steps.description: Follow the manual pattern. Seasonal sets: keep each wheel marked. Torque to placard spec in a star after the car is down.
steps.safety_warning: Jack stands before wheels off. Re-torque after 25–50 miles.
steps.trust_nudge: If a lug or wheel is seized and you're unsure, stop and find a nearby shop — that's the smart call, not quitting.
